description: Read available state from the connected Redux integration. Lists top-level slices by default; includeValues:true requests state values. Use get_events with sources:["redux"] for retained action history.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

includeValues.description: Include the full current state tree (HEAVY). Default false (slice names only).

name: get_redux_state
